frictions.description: Profile page at /start shows placeholder text 'Profile form will be available here' - no palette selection UI available. Had to test palette transitions by directly setting data attributes via eval.
frictions.resolution: Used document.documentElement.setAttribute() to change data-light-palette and data-dark-palette attributes directly, which still triggers CSS transitions since the palette definitions are CSS-based

summary: VAL-THEME-004 PASSES. The previously failing assertion now passes. CSS transition rules (background-color, color, border-color, box-shadow at 0.3s cubic-bezier) are correctly applied to all elements via the wildcard selector in src/index.css. Light/dark mode toggling and palette switching both produce smooth visual transitions with no flickering or layout shifts. No console errors detected.
